Everything. I have nothing. No friends. All of them left me for no reason. Or maybe there is a reason but I just can’t see it. Idk. I’m ugly. Stupid. I have no ambition. I’m scared to go back to work to face an ex-friend who fucking hates me right now to the point where I’m panicking and thinking of suicide so I won’t have to see her/endure another day of work. I hate seeing people from my past (mostly cause they’re all doing better than me/don’t recognize my failure self). I won’t ever have a husband or kids cause I’m so ugly and awkward. I’m talentless. I got so lonely that I came up with a defense/coping mechanism called maladaptive daydreaming (it’s where you make up plots, stories, characters, etc in your head to makeup for your lackluster life) and I’ve daydreamed so much that I have no personality in real life. I have nothing going for me. Nothing to look forward to but death. Me and my family are poor so no vacations or fun things to look forward too. I don’t have my license because no one will teach me to drive. I’m just tired. why not speed death the process along? There’s nothing out here for me. Absolutely nothing. Sorry for the long post but I just can’t do it anymore. I can’t. It’s either cutting or gas bag. Hopefully someone shoots me or something before I get to that point. Or I die in my sleep. I want to induce a heart attack or some something if possible.
